study: Idea 17 diagnostic: daily-bias direction filter versus decisive daily-bias threshold

frozenSpec.dailyBias: prior completed NIFTY trading day close versus open; UP if close>open, DOWN if close<open, FLAT if equal.
frozenSpec.decisiveBias: UP/DOWN only when absolute prior-day open-to-close return >= 0.5%; otherwise FLAT.
frozenSpec.entryGate: trade direction must agree with the selected daily bias; FLAT or disagreement means no trade.
frozenSpec.lookahead: none; only prior completed day is used.
frozenSpec.source: retrospective filter on the frozen Idea 10A baseline trade set; Idea 10A signal/confirmation/exit mechanics are unchanged.
